title: fix(plugin-chatbot,app-shell): the follow-up sent to the model after Confirm or Cancel is no longer shown as the person's message
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3raJW9Z4ixrGxfuEz9hefp)_

Fixes #30223

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：聊天确认卡片点「确认」或「取消」后，系统发给模型的那段续写指令（`[HITL pa_…] The operator approved …`）不再显示成用户自己的气泡，对话列表预览也不再显示它；模型照常收到这段文字。
- 为什么改：客户在自己那一侧看到一大段带 id 和 JSON 的英文，像泄露或故障；重新打开对话、左侧对话列表里也一直显示它。
- 风险与回滚：只改界面读取，存储和发给模型的内容一字不变；识别靠续写文字开头的 `[HITL 编号]` 标记，用户自己恰好以这种格式开头打字才会被误隐藏。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/hitlContinuation.ts`（标记的唯一出处）、`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 中 `isHitlContinuation` 那一行、`useConversationList.ts` 的 `extractPreview`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/hitlContinuation-30223.test.tsx`，预期 5 例全绿；截图见下方 Verification。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One marker, one module.** New `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/hitlContinuation.ts` owns the continuation tag: `hitlContinuationTag(id)` writes `[HITL PA_ID]`, `isHitlContinuation(text)` reads it (tag at the very start, one non-space id, then a space). `useHitlInChat` now builds its prompt with `hitlContinuationTag`, so producer and reader cannot drift. The text sent to the model is byte-identical to before.
- **Transcript.** `ChatbotEnhanced` draws no bubble for a user message whose content is a continuation. That one seam covers the live chat, a reloaded conversation, the dock (it mounts the same `ChatPane`) and the shared-transcript page (it renders `ChatbotEnhanced` read-only).
- **Conversation list preview.** `useConversationList`'s `extractPreview` reads past continuations to the person's last real ask; a server-supplied `preview` that is a continuation is dropped too. The list's search haystack is built from the same `preview`, so search stops matching the continuation as well.
- **Conversation-language probe.** `detectConversationLanguage` (app-shell) skipped nothing: after a confirm, the latest "user" turn was the English continuation, so a Chinese conversation's outbound text (plan approve, change-confirm send text) turned English whenever the action's result carried no Chinese. It now reads past the continuation. Same marker, same defect class (the continuation read as the person's turn), one line.
- **Export.** `isHitlContinuation` is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core` (the app-shell readers import it from `./core`, which stays side-effect free). The producer `hitlContinuationTag` stays internal.

## Why

The ruling asked to prefer a marker carried on the message (metadata or a part flag) over the `[HITL …]` prefix, and to stop if the clean fix needs a server change. Measured: **nothing but the text survives storage.**

- The agent route collapses an inbound UI message's `parts` to their joined text (`normalizeMessage` in `@objectstack/service-ai`), and `addMessage` persists `content` as that string.
- `ai_messages` has the columns `id`, `conversation_id`, `role`, `content`, `tool_calls`, `tool_call_id`, `turn_id` and token/latency columns; no column holds message metadata. `GET /conversations/:id` rebuilds each user message as `{ role: 'user', content: row.content }`.
- The share endpoint's raw rows (`RawAiMessageRow` in `useChatConversation.ts`) carry the same columns.

Read from the last published `@objectstack/service-ai` (10.3.0, the npm tarball); the current service-ai is Cloud/EE and not in this repository, so its source was not read. The staging evidence on the card (the continuation text in the stored history and the list preview) agrees. A UI `metadata` flag would therefore exist only until the first reload, and two markers would be two dialects. The leading tag is the one marker that round-trips, so it is the marker, and its spelling now lives in one module next to its reader. No server, REST or spec change.

Seam for a structural marker later, if wanted: `cloud:service-ai normalizeMessage + ai_messages (no metadata column) → renderer:ChatbotEnhanced, app-shell:useConversationList`.

## Tests

New pins (all on the real hooks and renderer, no component mocks):

- `plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/hitlContinuation-30223.test.tsx` — `useHitlInChat` decides over a mocked pending-actions endpoint and hands its continuation to the REAL `useObjectChat` transport. 确认 leg and 取消 leg: the captured chat POST's last user message is the full continuation, tag first (the model-facing payload); the hook holds it as a user message; `ChatbotEnhanced` (through `toRuntimeMessages`, as the console page does) draws the person's ask and no continuation. CONTROL: an ordinary typed message is sent verbatim and drawn. Reader unit: the producer's tag reads true; ordinary text, a tag not at the start, `[HITL]` with no id and non-strings read false.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/hitlContinuation-30223.test.tsx` — reload leg over stored rows through the real hydration path (`aiMessageRowsToServerMessages` → `toUIMessages` → `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` → `ChatbotEnhanced`): the continuation hydrates as a user message and draws no bubble; CONTROL: an ordinary stored user message still draws. Language probe: a Chinese ask followed by an English continuation stays `zh-CN`; CONTROL: an English turn the person typed still decides.
- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConversationList.hitlContinuation-30223.test.tsx` — the confirmed conversation previews the ask, not the continuation stored after it; CONTROL: a conversation without a confirm previews its last user message unchanged; a conversation holding only a continuation (and a served `preview` equal to it) gets no preview rather than the continuation.

<details><summary>Ablation (one per reader; mutation landed, restored, blob == HEAD)</summary>

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on commit `6244d3a5`; each mutation reported `anchor 1 -> 0` and each restore `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The ui suites import `@object-ui/*` from source, so no rebuild between legs.

- A1 `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: `if (isUser && isHitlContinuation(message.content)) return null;` → `… && false …`. Red: 确认 leg, 取消 leg, reload leg (3 failed / 6 passed; every CONTROL stayed green).
- A2 `useConversationList.ts`: `if (text && !isHitlContinuation(text)) return text;` → `if (text) return text;`. Red: `Expected "把这条状态改成 Active"`, `Received "[HITL pa_8cf40802-… The operator approved the update_record call…"`.
- A3 `conversationLanguage.ts`: the `continue` on a continuation disabled. Red: "a Chinese conversation stays Chinese after an English continuation" (1 failed / 3 passed).

</details>

<details><summary>Suites and type-check</summary>

On `6244d3a5` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, from `ui/`:

- `vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` — Test Files 95 passed (95), Tests 880 passed (880).
- `vitest run` over the 140 app-shell test files that import `useConversationList`, `conversationLanguage`, `AiChatPage`, `ConversationsSidebar` or `ChatDock` — Test Files 140 passed (140), Tests 992 passed (992). Narrowed: the rest of app-shell does not import a touched module; CI's Test UI runs it all.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` first exited 2 on the new test (hook output handed to `ChatbotEnhanced` without `toRuntimeMessages`); fixed in `f572a55d`, then exit 0.

After merging `origin/main` (`632f7d95`): the three new files plus `useHitlInChat.test.tsx` — Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 19 passed (19).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card Acceptance.** (1) After 确认 or 取消 no continuation bubble: hidden (the one-line note option was not taken; it would need a new label in all ten locale packs). (2) The model still receives the continuation: pinned on the captured chat POST. (3) A reloaded conversation does not show it, including the conversation list (comment 6648541899): pinned on the hydration path and on `useConversationList`.
- **Recognition is by the leading tag.** A person who types a message that itself starts with `[HITL ` + an id + `] ` would not see that bubble. The tag is not something the product ever asks a person to type.
- **Out of scope, reported not fixed** (the card's two smaller things): the assistant reply sometimes names the record by its id (that is model wording over the result JSON, which carries `recordId` and a `link` with the label); the record page behind the dock does not refresh after a chat write. Neither is touched here.
- **File surface beyond the claim's list.** Besides `useHitlInChat.ts`, the transcript renderer and the list-preview reader, this diff adds `plugin-chatbot/src/hitlContinuation.ts`, two export lines (`core.ts`, `index.tsx`) and the language-probe line in `app-shell/src/console/ai/conversationLanguage.ts` (another reader of the same stored turn, same defect class).

## Verification

Live leg NOT run: the in-product agent runtime (`@objectstack/service-ai`) is Cloud/EE and absent from the open framework (`/ai/**` answers 501 there), and no LLM provider is configured in this container. Closest deterministic fixture instead:

- The mock-transport legs above (real `useHitlInChat` + real `useObjectChat` transport + real renderer).
- A real-Chromium render of the console's own modules (a scratch dev-server page, not committed): `ConversationsSidebar` over a stubbed `GET /conversations`, beside `ChatbotEnhanced`, both fed a transcript with one confirmed update and one cancelled create. Before (both readers swapped back to `origin/main`, served code checked): the cancel continuation shows as a user bubble and as the list preview. After: neither; the list previews the last real ask 「再新建一个客户 验收客户 R6」. Text probe of the page: before `chatHasHitl: true, listHasHitl: true`; after `false, false`. Shots: `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30223-shots/before-fix.png`, `after-fix.png` (project files).
